candidates.text_version: Masoretic Aramaic displayed with English translation on Sefaria
candidates.similarity: Daniel's prayer is explicitly oriented toward Jerusalem, illustrating directionally oriented worship.
candidates.difference: Daniel kneels toward Jerusalem despite a royal prohibition; the Qur'anic verses discuss a direction change and command orientation to the Sacred Mosque. No shared event or identifiable literary quotation.
candidates.caveat: Important verse-numbering variation; original is Aramaic rather than Hebrew. Distinguish setting of narrative from debated composition and extant witness dates.
